name: DownUnder
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to DownUnder in Tirol – the ultimate adventure playground in the heart of the Alps!** **

Your Thrilling Escape Awaits

** Nestled between the majestic **Zillertal Alps** and the **Kitzbühel Alps**, **DownUnder** is the world’s first **underground adventure park**—a high-energy mix of **indoor skydiving**, **bungee jumping**, **trampolining**, and **ninja warrior courses**. Whether you're an adrenaline junkie or just looking for a wild day out, this is your playground. **

Indoor Skydiving – Feel the Rush!

** Strap in and experience the **free-fall sensation** of skydiving—**indoors**! With **vertical wind tunnels** and **professional instructors**, you’ll soar through the air like a bird. Perfect for beginners and pros alike! **

Bungee Jumping – Dare to Defy Gravity?

** Take the leap from **100 meters high** and feel the adrenaline surge as you bounce back up. **DownUnder** offers **bungee platforms** with breathtaking views of the **Tirol** landscape—your heart will race! **

Trampoline Park – Jump, Flip, Fly!

** Unleash your inner acrobat in our **massive trampoline arena**. With **dodgeball, freestyle zones, and foam pits**, every jump is an adventure. Great for families and thrill-seekers! **

Ninja Warrior – Test Your Skills!

** Climb, swing, and conquer **obstacle courses** designed to push your limits. Can you make it to the top? Challenge yourself and your friends in this **high-energy ninja challenge**! **

Dine & Relax – Fuel for Adventure

** After your adrenaline fix, recharge at **DownUnder’s restaurant & bar**. Savor **Tirol’s finest**—from hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** to **Obatzda** and **Tiroler Gröstl**. Wash it down with a **local beer** or a refreshing **Apfelschorle**. **

Location & Opening Hours

** **DownUnder** is just **10 minutes from Innsbruck**, making it the perfect stop on your **Tirol** adventure. Open daily from **10 AM to 10 PM**—adventure never sleeps! **

Book Your Ticket Now!

** Ready to dive into the action? **Secure your spot** online and get ready for the **ride of your life** in **Tirol**! 🚀 **Visit DownUnder Tirol**
